clauses.zh: 近黑哑纹背景留出连续暗面，以单一、可辨的巨形围住微型世界，保留一两处载体结构。
clauses.en: Leave continuous matte near-black space around a single recognizable silhouette enclosing a miniature world. Preserve one or two identifying features.

clauses.zh: 靛紫和蓝紫建立暗面与空间，玫红连接内外光色，少量桃金和近白作峰值。细冷缘光强弱有别。
clauses.en: Use indigo and blue-violet for depth, repeat rose-magenta inside and outside, and reserve peach-gold and near-white for peak light. Vary the thin cool rim.

clauses.zh: 内景由大气色面、窄幅精细地标和较宽的前景笔触分层。局部清楚，其余简化。
clauses.en: Layer a broad atmospheric mass, a narrow detailed landmark band and broader foreground strokes. Resolve the local anchor and simplify its surroundings.

clauses.zh: 载体以顺形薄笔塑造，内景用较厚的不透明叠笔；前景断笔顺承接面走势，飞点限于接口附近。
clauses.en: Model the carrier with thin directional strokes, use thicker opaque strokes inside, and orient broken foreground marks along the receiving surface. Confine flecks near the junction.

clauses.zh: 绝大部分边界可追踪，在一处可信接口逐渐消隐，让同一内光延续到外部并衰减回黑。
clauses.en: Keep most of the silhouette traceable. Dissolve one plausible junction so the same inner light continues outward and fades into black.

clauses.zh: 画出 {{carrier}}，以 {{identity_marks}} 保证外形可辨。
把 {{inner_world}} 纳入轮廓，以 {{landmark}} 作内部的小型地标。
clauses.en: Enclose {{inner_world}} within the silhouette, with {{landmark}} as its small focal landmark.

clauses.zh: 从 {{junction}} 将内光送到 {{receiver}}，让笔触顺应它的方向。
clauses.en: At {{junction}}, carry the inner light onto {{receiver}} and follow its direction.
